admission.capacityNote: Numerus fixus, selected by the university itself. Maastricht states it cannot offer a place to every applicant who meets the admission requirements. Studielink and every admission task in the MyApplication portal must both be complete by 23:59 CET on 15 January; ranking numbers follow on 15 April.

selection.description: An International Classroom Essay submitted as a webform, assessed on motivation, plans for the future and how you look at the world.
The grades of your penultimate year of secondary school — for an IB student, DP1.
A separate International Classroom requirement, judged on the same essay. Failing it removes you from the ranking altogether, and the same decision applies to Economics and Business Economics.

requirements.label: A full IB Diploma

officialWording.text: To qualify for admission to a bachelor's programme at Maastricht University (UM), you must hold a secondary school diploma that is considered equivalent to the Dutch pre-university VWO diploma.

requirements.note: Nuffic compares the full IB Diploma to a VWO diploma. Maastricht warns separately that being VWO-equivalent does not by itself satisfy a programme's additional subject requirements, which are assessed on their own.

requirements.label: IB mathematics, either course, either level

officialWording.text: International Business — Mathematics Analysis and Approaches SL/HL or Mathematics Applications and Interpretation SL/HL

requirements.note: Both IB mathematics courses are accepted at either level and no minimum grade is published, which makes this the most permissive mathematics rule in this catalogue — and it is the same university that will not accept Applications and Interpretation at all for Data Science. The alternatives are recorded at SL because HL satisfies an SL rule; the engine compares levels, it does not require an exact match.

requirements.label: Documented English proficiency
requirements.note: Maastricht resolves the English requirement through an interactive questionnaire on the programme page rather than by publishing a list, so the exact wording of the IB exemption could not be captured. It is recorded as satisfied by a full IB Diploma taught in English, which is how every other institution in this catalogue treats it, and flagged here as the one requirement on this Opportunity that rests on a pattern rather than on a quoted sentence. Confirm it on the programme page.

requirements.label: The International Classroom Essay — 33 per cent of the selection score, and a gate

officialWording.text: International Classroom Essay (33%); Curriculum vitae + supporting documents (33%); Grades of your penultimate year of secondary school (33%)

requirements.note: This one item does two jobs and a student needs to know both. It carries a third of the ranking score, and it is also judged separately against an International Classroom requirement: "If your profile is not sufficient to meet the International Classroom requirement, you will not be included in the ranking procedure." That is not a ranking outcome, it is exclusion. And the decision carries across to Economics and Business Economics, so the obvious fallback is not one.

requirements.label: Curriculum vitae and supporting documents — 33 per cent
requirements.note: A Selection Factor. CAS, part-time work, competitions and anything else documented belongs here, and it carries exactly as much weight as your grades do.

requirements.label: The grades of your penultimate school year — 33 per cent
requirements.note: A Selection Factor. For an IB student these are DP1 grades, not predicted grades and not final ones. Recorded as kind 'other' because the requirement model has no kind for a grade average, though admission.selection[].type does.

officialRequirementsText.text: International Business — Mathematics Analysis and Approaches SL/HL or Mathematics Applications and Interpretation SL/HL. International Business is a numerus fixus programme with selection by the educational institution.

notes: Numerus fixus: 15 January 2027 at 23:59 CET, and it does not reopen. You may hold at most two numerus fixus applications nationally in one year.
Two thirds of the selection score is not your grades. An essay and a CV outweigh them, and both are written in January.
The International Classroom requirement is assessed once and the decision binds for Economics and Business Economics too, so the two cannot be used as a hedge against each other.

The subject requirement is published for 2027-2028 and is firm. The selection weighting and the deadline table were still showing 2026-2027 when read, so those are recorded as last published rather than confirmed for 2027.
Not established: the number of places.
